description: Use for broad robotics source/reference discovery or a small candidate-only list. For an executable starting point with prior fixes and setup argv, prefer start_robot_task. Use short task keywords, or query_mode=task with known runtime/robot filters for English sentences. Follow recovery suggestions after empty results. Results distinguish prepared recipes from upstream references; a match is not runtime verification.

q.description: Default all_terms: all query terms must match word prefixes. Standalone A*, D* and RRT* are read as astar, dstar and rrtstar; embedded identifiers and repeated stars keep ordinary tokenization. Empty q browses.

query_mode.description: task opts into ASCII English lexical ranking over at most512 hard-filtered records; narrow runtime/robot when query_too_broad. No execution or compatibility inference.

name: find_robot_skills
